startScreen.title: Confidence Boost
description: Use these questions whenever you need perspective.
Answer with something you actually did, changed, or survived.

endScreen.title: You Did It!
endScreen.subtitle: Confidence is easier to trust when you can point to where it came from.

confidence.name: Confidence
confidence.description: Questions to help you remember your strengths and resilience.

questions.question: What is one difficult thing you handled better than the old version of you would have?
Which insecurity has lost some of its authority over you?
What part of your current life would surprise your younger self most?
Whose courage do you recognize in your own behavior?
When did saying no protect something important?
When did saying yes require more courage than people could see?
What achievement have you minimized because celebrating it might feel embarrassing?
When did you last speak before you felt fully ready?
Which promise to yourself have you quietly kept?
What strength would someone who knows you well name without hesitation?
